I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message: the depot was **Southgate**. Priyanka posted in #inc-tansley-carrier-api on 2025-09-03 that, while label printing was stalled, Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her later update that day said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address or other site details for Southgate in that channel or in the shared files Tobias can see. I told him to ask Priyanka if he needs more than the name. Tobias is a member of that channel, so I didn't look at anything he can't see himself.
